title: Maya: Last Bus
label: Concept board · photographer × producer × Maya · shoot window: <month year>
intro: One concept, one real place, one night: a short film in eight stills. Real photos of the location are marked as real, with credit and year; storyboard frames are AI sketches of the look and the action, not of the final light.

head: Concept
Where
When
Look
rows: Concrete bus shelter at the edge of town (free, public)
Direct flash + one red gel, slow shutter

chapters.title: Last Bus
chapters.logline: She missed the last bus. Someone else's flowers were waiting for her.
real: The shelter as it looks today: grey precast concrete wall, a long wooden-slat bench, a scratched clear side panel, one orange streetlamp, gravel shoulder and dry scrub behind. Checked from photos taken this year.

photos.cap: The shelter from across the road

places.name: Bus shelter, <road>, <town>
places.body: Shoot from the far shoulder for the wides; the road is quiet after the last bus. A spotter watches traffic; no gear on the asphalt.

chapters.logistics: Arrive 30 min before blue hour. Parking on the gravel 50 m before the shelter. No permit needed for a small crew without blocking the shelter; leave it free for anyone waiting.

root.label: The root
root.quote: Flowers found on your path are meant for you.
root.text: An old folk superstition, and the universal small tragedy of the missed last bus. The story turns a bad night into a found gift.

frames.title: Gone
frames.action: The bus pulls away in red streaks; Maya runs, one heel in her hand.
frames.camera: Wide from across the road · 1/4 s · rear-curtain flash

frames.title: Kerb
frames.action: She stops, kicks off the other heel, watches the lights shrink.

frames.title: The bouquet
frames.action: Through the side panel: flowers alone on the bench, a sealed card.
frames.camera: Through the polycarbonate · her reflection over the flowers

frames.title: The card
frames.action: She reads it, grins, tucks one flower behind her ear.

frames.title: Encore
frames.action: On the bench, bouquet as a microphone; her giant red shadow on the wall.
frames.camera: Wide inside the shelter · red gel low right

frames.title: Hitchhiker
frames.action: Headlights: she holds the bouquet out like a sign, staring into the lens.

frames.title: Petals
frames.action: Wind from the car tears petals past her laughing face.
frames.camera: Low close-up · 1/8 s · flash freezes the face

frames.title: Left behind
frames.action: The card and her heels on the bench; she walks away barefoot.

prod: Black satin slip over an opaque black bodysuit (hers), cropped denim jacket (hers), black strappy heels (hers). To buy: a bouquet of in-season flowers in kraft paper, ~<price>; a cream envelope.
Direct flash on camera for most frames; one strobe with a red gel low and bare for frame 5 (see diagram) and as the 'headlights' backlight for frames 6-7. Slow shutter for trails; rear-curtain sync.
Blue hour only (~40 min): shoot frames 1, 2 and 8 first while the sky still holds colour. Spotter for traffic. Total cost: the flowers.

sections.html:
Order

Wides first (1, 2, 8), then the shelter frames (3-5), then the headlight frames (6-7).

Bring

Camera + wide lens, on-camera flash, one strobe + red gel + stand, sandbag, the bouquet, a towel for her feet.

Don't bring

Haze (public road), anything that blocks the shelter.
